_comment: Copy to tools/screener_config.json (gitignored) and fill in your screen_url(s). screen_url = the address-bar URL of your saved screener.in screen; the fetcher finds its Export-to-Excel form and posts it with your cookie. Use 'url' instead for a direct-download link (e.g. a Google Sheets .../export?format=csv). kind = 'screener' (weekly universe) or 'stage2'.
